fusions.name: Royal Reach
fusions.desc: Points a decree across the water that deals 16 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and stuns the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Edict Wave
fusions.desc: A wave that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignores their resistances.

fusions.name: Summons to Court
fusions.desc: A command that pulls up to 6 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Crowned Current
fusions.desc: Conjures a crown for your head: your critical chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 0.15x more, each kill restores 2 health and your maximum health rises by 12.
